content:
q08. **Driver** — defined at `store/driver.go:10`

This is the interface all database backends implement (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite), covering connection lifecycle (`GetDB`, `Close`, `IsInitialized`, `GetDatabaseSize`) plus full CRUD methods for every store model (attachments, memos, users, settings, inbox, reactions, etc.). The concrete implementations are confirmed at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:14` (`mysql.DB`), `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:16` (`postgres.DB`), and `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:16` (`sqlite.DB`).
